# Nuclear Digital
https://www.newcleardigital.com/llms.txt

## About
Nuclear Digital is a software development and digital services agency building cutting-edge digital products for startups, scale-ups, and enterprise clients. We design and ship custom web applications, AI-powered platforms, and enterprise software that sits at the intersection of engineering craft and purposeful design. Founded by Stoyan Dimitrov.

## Services
- Custom web application development (React, Next.js, TypeScript)
- Mobile app development
- AI integration and automation
- UI/UX design and design systems
- Enterprise software solutions
- API design and backend development
- Digital strategy and consulting

## Locations
- Sofia, Bulgaria (headquarters)
- Remote — serving clients globally

## What Makes Us Different
Nuclear Digital operates at the forefront of technology, using cutting-edge tools and innovative approaches to build software that feels ahead of its time. Every product we ship combines engineering precision with design craft — not outsourced, not templated. We build from scratch with the latest technologies to give clients a genuine competitive edge.

## Ideal Clients
Startups and scale-ups launching new digital products. Enterprise teams modernising legacy systems. Founders who want software that looks and performs like the best products in the world.
